name: wound-care-tracker
title: Wound Care Tracker
description: Longitudinal wound healing evaluation recording dimensions (length, width, depth), percentage area reduction, exudate, and dressings.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Activity, AlertTriangle, ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight, Calendar, CheckCircle2, Clock, Crosshair, Layers, Plus, Ruler, TrendingDown, TrendingUp, } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { ClinicalStatusBadge } from "@/components/medicn/clinical-status-badge" export type WoundType = "pressure" | "surgical" | "diabetic" | "venous" | "arterial" | "trauma" export type WoundStage = "stage1" | "stage2" | "stage3" | "stage4" | "unstageable" | "dti" | "na" export interface WoundAssessment { id: string date: string lengthCm: number widthCm: number depthCm?: number areaCm2?: number stage?: WoundStage exudateAmount?: "none" | "scant" | "small" | "moderate" | "large" exudateType?: "serous" | "serosanguinous" | "sanguineous" | "purulent" granulationPercent?: number sloughPercent?: number escharPercent?: number periwound?: string painLevel?: number dressingApplied?: string assessor?: string } export interface Wound { id: string location: string type: WoundType acquiredDate: string assessments: WoundAssessment[] } export const WOUND_TYPE_LABELS: Record = { pressure: "Pressure Injury", surgical: "Surgical Wound / Dehiscence", diabetic: "Diabetic Neuropathic Ulcer", venous: "Venous Stasis Ulcer", arterial: "Arterial Ischemic Ulcer", trauma: "Traumatic Laceration / Tear", } export const WOUND_STAGE_LABELS: Record = { stage1: "Stage 1 (Non-blanchable erythema)", stage2: "Stage 2 (Partial thickness skin loss)", stage3: "Stage 3 (Full thickness skin loss)", stage4: "Stage 4 (Full thickness tissue loss to bone/muscle)", unstageable: "Unstageable (Obscured by slough/eschar)", dti: "Deep Tissue Injury (DTI)", na: "Not Applicable", } export function calculateWoundArea(length: number, width: number): number { return Math.round(length * width * 10) / 10 } export function calculateAreaReduction(initialArea: number, currentArea: number): number { if (initialArea <= 0) return 0 const reduction = ((initialArea - currentArea) / initialArea) * 100 return Math.round(reduction) } export interface WoundCareTrackerProps extends Omit, "title"> { wound: Wound onAddAssessment?: (woundId: string) => void readOnly?: boolean title?: React.ReactNode } export function WoundCareTracker({ wound, onAddAssessment, readOnly = false, title = "Wound Assessment & Healing Tracker", className, ...props }: WoundCareTrackerProps) { const assessments = wound.assessments ?? [] const initial = assessments[0] const latest = assessments[assessments.length - 1] const initialArea = initial ? (initial.areaCm2 ?? calculateWoundArea(initial.lengthCm, initial.widthCm)) : 0 const currentArea = latest ? (latest.areaCm2 ?? calculateWoundArea(latest.lengthCm, latest.widthCm)) : 0 const reduction = initial && latest && assessments.length > 1 ? calculateAreaReduction(initialArea, currentArea) : 0 const isImproving = reduction > 0 return (

{title}

Longitudinal Tissue Healing & Dimensions

{!readOnly && onAddAssessment && ( )}
{/* Wound Header Info */}
Anatomic Location

{wound.location}

{WOUND_TYPE_LABELS[wound.type]}

Current Dimensions {latest ? (

{latest.lengthCm} × {latest.widthCm} {latest.depthCm != null ? `× ${latest.depthCm}` : ""} cm

Area: {currentArea} cm²

) : (

No assessments recorded

)}
Trajectory
{assessments.length > 1 ? ( <> {reduction}% Area Reduction {isImproving ? "Healing" : "Stalled"} ) : ( Baseline established )}
{/* Longitudinal Assessments Log */}
Assessment History ({assessments.length}) {assessments.length === 0 ? (
No clinical wound assessments logged.
) : (
{assessments.map((a, idx) => { const area = a.areaCm2 ?? calculateWoundArea(a.lengthCm, a.widthCm) return (
{a.date} {a.stage && ( {WOUND_STAGE_LABELS[a.stage]?.split(" ")[0]} {WOUND_STAGE_LABELS[a.stage]?.split(" ")[1]} )}
{a.lengthCm} cm (L) × {a.widthCm} cm (W) {area} cm²
Exudate: {a.exudateAmount ?? "None"} {a.exudateType ? `(${a.exudateType})` : ""}
{a.dressingApplied && (
Dressing: {a.dressingApplied}
)}
{a.assessor && (
Evaluated by: {a.assessor}
)}
) })}
)}
) }
